# TSM-server-changer 2.0 

**TSM-server-changer 2.0** 是一款基於 **Fabric** 的 Minecraft 客戶端 Mod，  
它可以自動將玩家切換到「2 服」，避免掛機或斷線重連時掉回「1 服」。

## 功能

- **自動伺服器切換**  
  當玩家連線到 `mc.stud3nt.xyz` 伺服器時，Mod 會自動發送切換指令，無需手動操作。

- **掛機與重連支援**  
  即使伺服器重啟或斷線重連，Mod 也能確保玩家自動回到「2 服」，提升遊戲體驗。

- **輕量 & 易用**  
  不修改遊戲核心功能，安裝簡單，無額外配置需求。

## 為什麼下載

- 避免掛機時掉回「1 服」，節省手動切換的時間。  
- 專為喜愛在「2 服」活動的玩家設計，提升連線穩定性與便利性。

## 致謝

本 Mod 改編自 [CharlesHsu 的 TSM_server_changer](https://github.com/CharlesHsu-noob/TSM_server_changer)

# TSM-server-changer 2.0 (English Description)

**TSM-server-changer 2.0** is a Minecraft client mod based on **Fabric** that automatically switches players to "Server 2", preventing issues with AFK reconnects or server restarts.

## Features

- **Auto Server Switch**  
  Automatically sends the server switch command when connecting to `mc.stud3nt.xyz`, no manual action required.

- **AFK & Reconnect Support**  
  Ensures players return to "Server 2" even after server restarts or disconnections, improving gameplay experience.

- **Lightweight & Easy-to-Use**  
  Does not modify core game functionality, simple installation, no extra configuration needed.

## Why Download

- Avoid returning to "Server 1" while AFK, saving manual switching time.  
- Designed for players who prefer "Server 2", enhancing connection stability and convenience.

## Credits

Adapted from [CharlesHsu's TSM_server_changer](https://github.com/CharlesHsu-noob/TSM_server_changer)
